products.name: Figma AI
products.note: Design AI; auto-layout; content generation; design system governance; Adobe acquisition context

profile_text.body:
Figma is a for-profit public company (ticker: FIG, CIK: 0001579878) that provides a collaborative design platform. The company describes itself as "the canvas where design, code, and AI come together," positioning its product as a single workspace where teams can move from initial concept to shipped product. Its site emphasizes that human teammates and AI agents share the same working environment and context throughout that process.

Figma's AI offering, tracked here as Figma AI, sits in the image and graphic design category and encompasses features the company describes as covering design direction generation, refinement, and alignment within the shared canvas. The product is also noted in connection with auto-layout, content generation, and design system governance, as well as the context of a prior Adobe acquisition attempt.
